column1: # Val Ark - grid-down ESSENTIALS: what the box must hold first if the internet
# disappears tomorrow. The planner takes these in rank order BEFORE any other
# phase, choosing the SMALLEST variant that fits (mini/nopic ZIM), and skips any
# entry that does not fit instead of stopping, so a tiny disk still gets the most
# critical small items and a big disk later adds the full variants as usual.
#   kind   zim   -> fnmatch on the Kiwix ZIM base name (e.g. zimgit-water_en)
#          model -> fnmatch on the data/models-extra.tsv id
#          inst  -> fnmatch on the data/installers.tsv id
#   focus  all, or comma-separated owner profiles (balanced,knowledge,ai,tools,survival)
# --- life safety: water, medicine, food, shelter (all tiny) -------------------
12|zim|nhs.uk_en_medicines|all|What common medicines are for, doses, side effects
13|zim|irp.fas.org_en_military-medicine|all|Military field medicine manuals (trauma care without a hospital)
# --- a pocket encyclopedia + an assistant that can explain it ----------------
45|zim|ham.stackexchange.com_en_all|all|Amateur radio: communications with no internet or phone network
71|zim|wikipedia_en_all|all|All of Wikipedia (mini first; nopic/maxi later on bigger disks)
73|zim|armypubs_en_all|survival|Army field manuals: survival, engineering, first aid, water, shelter
